data.title: Build an adjustable bicycle fit proxy
data.summary: Wheelbase 1.02 m, saddle height 0.74 m and handlebar reach 0.48 m. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: The Python API can inspect and modify Blender data and run tools.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / COLMAP / Nerfstudio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: Wheelbase 1.02 m, saddle height 0.74 m and handlebar reach 0.48 m.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent bike fit proxy workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: Wheelbase 1.02 m, saddle height 0.74 m and handlebar reach 0.48 m. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Reuse an existing generic frame proxy and define wheel, crank, saddle and bar anchors
Drive the proxy from the three dimensions in a parameter table
Show side and perspective views with labelled landmarks; compare all coordinates

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned build an adjustable bicycle fit proxy candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Changing saddle height does not move wheel centers
The side-view dimensions reproduce the input table
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: This is a spatial planning proxy, not a medical fit recommendation or branded replica.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Use simple tubes to review fit relationships before adding surface detail.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me build an adjustable bicycle fit proxy in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: Wheelbase 1.02 m, saddle height 0.74 m and handlebar reach 0.48 m. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Changing saddle height does not move wheel centers; The side-view dimensions reproduce the input table. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
